About

My accounting background taught me to check every number and to explain what it means. Today I use that habit in data analysis: cleaning messy data, finding the pattern, and presenting it in a dashboard that anyone on the team can use.

I have worked in accounting since 2016 and in data analysis since 2023, and I am looking for a data analyst role where I can work with financial and business data.

Retail Inventory Performance 2023

One project, two dashboards: discounts, and seasonality

Discounts and Categories

Discount levels versus sales across five categories

Compares sales with discount levels for Clothing, Electronics, Furniture, Groceries and Toys. Net sales reached $246M, down 1%, with $27.6M given in discounts. Mid-level discounts (5% to 10%) produced the most sales at $100M, ahead of high discounts ($92M) and no discount ($54M). Toys and Clothing lead by category.

Seasonality and Promotions

When sales happen and where discounts go

Shows how time and weather affect sales. Winter is the strongest season at $72.2M and autumn the weakest at $52.5M. Holidays bring $131M compared with $115M on workdays, and sunny weather has the highest sales of all weather types. Toys and Clothing take about 65% of all discounts.

ECO Sales Dashboard 2022

Orders, cancellations and customer experience

Looks at 2022 sales, campaigns, cancellations and customers. Net sales were $631.9K from 336 orders. Cancellations stay at 7% to 9% for normal delivery but jump to 50% when delivery is extremely delayed. Summer Boost was the best campaign at $134.9K, and sales are spread across six cities and four product subcategories.

Call Center Dashboard 2024

Agent performance and deal closing

Tracks 18.3k calls made by the sales team in 2024: 3.6k were reached and 1.3k ended in a closed deal. Agents are grouped into four performance levels. The Star group earned $290k from 6,699 calls, while the group that needs closing support made the most calls (7,297) but only $77k, which shows where coaching will help most.

Amazon Sales Analysis Dashboard

Revenue, profit, customers and payment methods

Built in Excel from 20,200 cleaned orders (2022 to 2023), using pivot tables and slicers for year, month, country, category, payment method, rating and customer segment. The 2023 view shows $6.7M revenue and $335.2K profit, both up 1%. Revenue is spread evenly across the four countries ($1.63M to $1.71M each) and the six categories, with Beauty in the lead at 17.5% of sales. VIP customers bring $4.1M, far more than moderate ($1.7M) and one-time ($895K) customers, and credit is the top payment method in every region.
